**Yes, A.** Under the majority rule, an employer's continued employment of an at-will employee is adequate consideration for a post-hire covenant not to compete, particularly when it lasts a substantial period, as the two years here did. The team note says a post-hire covenant is a modification that needs no new consideration, but that isn't the general rule. A modification that adds a new burden for the employee usually needs consideration, so B is wrong. C is wrong because courts don't weigh the *adequacy* of consideration but still require that some exists.

CONFIDENCE: 80
